title: Outside services as a table; each card's Test
why: Jason, 2026-11-17: "maybe we treat it like the table view with search and filters sorting". 1. System Configuration → Outside services is a table: one row per company with its name, what we use it for, its status ✓/✗/— (the same status as its pre-flight line), this month's cost and when it was last checked. 2. Search across names, uses and key names (TAVILY_API_KEY finds Tavily). 3. One filter dropdown: needs a look, in use, not in use, or a kind (storage, email, payments, AI, sign-in, data sources, domains, workers, hosting), with counts. 4. Sort by status (the default), company name or this month's cost, from the column heads. 5. A row opens today's full card in place, nothing dropped; the search, filter and sort are remembered in this browser; a link to #svc-<company> (the pre-flight's ✗, the admin search) opens its row. 6. Each card starts with Test: it runs the company's pre-flight check and the row's mark follows. 7. The pre-flight's Brave line now checks BRAVE_API_KEY like Tavily's (Jason: both must be live and ready; which one a workflow uses is the workflow's concern).
